issues.title: Close the live clipboard proof gap
issues.symptom: Clipboard paste can regress in GTK/WebKit or land in the wrong map terminal.
issues.rootCause: The existing guards cover wiring and logic but not the real desktop focus and clipboard path.
issues.nextAction: Add the live verifier and run it on the installed dock release.

issues.title: Guard map freeze and reflow decisions
issues.symptom: Map nodes can choose the wrong layout mode when the surface grows or shrinks.
issues.rootCause: The decision heuristic is not independently covered by a focused state test.
issues.nextAction: Lock the layout decision with a pure regression before changing it.

issues.title: Make status polling rules independently testable
issues.symptom: A refactor can reintroduce cold-start status gaps or unwanted desktop polling.
issues.rootCause: The polling decision is duplicated inline in terminal and map components.
issues.guard: Extract a pure polling decision helper and test it
issues.nextAction: Create the helper and focused regression before editing the polling paths.
